label: QQE smoothed RSI
gloss: the QQE smoothed RSI — a 5-period EMA of RSI(14), on the 0–100 RSI scale

label: QQE trailing stop
gloss: the QQE trailing stop, on the same 0–100 scale as the smoothed RSI it brackets

label: Parabolic SAR
gloss: the parabolic SAR stop level (step 0.02, max 0.2)

accelerationStart.description: The Parabolic SAR’s acceleration factor at the start of each trend.

accelerationIncrement.description: How much the acceleration factor grows at each new extreme of the trend.

accelerationMaximum.description: The most the acceleration factor can grow to.

label: Ichimoku conversion
gloss: the Ichimoku conversion line (tenkan, 9) — the midpoint of the 9-bar window ending at this bar

label: Ichimoku base
gloss: the Ichimoku base line (kijun, 26) — the midpoint of the 26-bar window ending at this bar

label: Ichimoku span A
gloss: the Ichimoku leading span A APPLYING at this bar — (conversion + base) / 2 as computed 25 bars ago

label: Ichimoku span B
gloss: the Ichimoku leading span B APPLYING at this bar — the 52-bar midpoint as computed 25 bars ago

label: Ichimoku lagging close
gloss: the close from 25 bars ago — the level the lagging span compares the current price against

label: Williams %R (14)
gloss: 14-period Williams %R — where the close sits in the 14-bar window ending at this bar, 0 at the high and −100 at the low

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: Stoch RSI %K
gloss: Stoch RSI %K (14,14,3,3) — where RSI(14) sits in its own 14-bar range, 0–100, smoothed over 3 bars

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

kSmoothing.description: The bars the stochastic’s %K is averaged over; 1 leaves it unsmoothed.

dSmoothing.description: The bars %K is averaged over to give %D, its signal line.

rsiPeriod.description: The length of the RSI the Stoch RSI reads its stochastic over.

label: Stoch RSI %D
gloss: Stoch RSI %D — the 3-bar mean of Stoch RSI %K, its signal line

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

kSmoothing.description: The bars the stochastic’s %K is averaged over; 1 leaves it unsmoothed.

dSmoothing.description: The bars %K is averaged over to give %D, its signal line.

rsiPeriod.description: The length of the RSI the Stoch RSI reads its stochastic over.

label: Pivot
gloss: the floor pivot, (the previous UTC day’s high + low + close) / 3

label: Pivot R1
gloss: the first floor resistance pivot, 2P − the previous UTC day’s low

label: Pivot R2
gloss: the second floor resistance pivot, P + the previous UTC day’s range

label: Pivot R3
gloss: the third floor resistance pivot, the previous UTC day’s high + 2 × (P − that day’s low)

label: Pivot S1
gloss: the first floor support pivot, 2P − the previous UTC day’s high

label: Pivot S2
gloss: the second floor support pivot, P − the previous UTC day’s range

label: Previous-day high
gloss: the previous UTC day’s high — the literal prior-day extreme, not a tracked swing pivot

label: Previous-day low
gloss: the previous UTC day’s low — the literal prior-day extreme, not a tracked swing pivot

label: Previous-day open
gloss: the previous UTC day’s opening print — the literal prior-day open, not a tracked swing pivot

label: TPO point of control (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the price bin holding the most time of the current week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

label: TPO value-area high (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the current week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

label: TPO value-area low (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the current week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

label: TPO point of control (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the price bin that held the most time of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: TPO value-area high (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: TPO value-area low (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: High (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the high of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: Low (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the low of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: TPO point of control (UTC month)
gloss: the price bin holding the most time of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

label: TPO value-area high (UTC month)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile
